quoi: Kind of second name for each of the 1,000 same-entity pairs of verification/paires-gleif-3.json (index = order of the match pairs in that file). same-name: the same name written differently; partial: the distinctive core shared, a distinctive word translated, added or dropped; other-name: another name of the same entity.
provenance: labelled on 2026-10-04 by two independent AI judges per batch of 500, blind to any matcher, score or code, reading only the names; an AI arbiter, blind to the judges' labels, settled their 174 disagreements by the written rule. Agreement before arbitration: 826 of 1000 (462 of 500 on the first batch, 364 of 500 on the second); 153 of the 174 disagreements were partial for one judge and same-name for the other. The arbiter was told that a trade word translated between languages, rather than transliterated, counts as a distinctive word translated; it labelled 168 of the 174 partial. The judges' own labels are kept below (jugeA, jugeB) so that any other settlement can be recomputed.
